channel.title: AI Engineering — Nicholas Garcia
channel.description: AI Engineering: agent orchestration, fleet operations, and the tooling behind this site.

item.title: An org chart for 11 software agents
item.description: Job titles and reporting lines in a version-controlled file, a command-line tool for asking a manager a question, a 48-hour escalation sweep and the status bug that misreported seven of 10 agents as broken.

item.title: An assistant that mines its own transcripts
item.description: A daily loop extracts four kinds of friction from an assistant's own session logs, proposes one change per cycle, gates it on a runnable check and halts when the changes stop helping.

item.title: Two memory stores, kept apart by design
item.description: One store holds rules and the other holds episodes. A write gate on the episodic store rejects rule-shaped entries and redirects them, which is what keeps either store useful.

item.title: 16 scheduled jobs run without supervision
item.description: An inventory of the AI agents running on one small server and a Mac, the eight rules that govern them and the four failures that produced those rules.
